```{=html}
<div id="map-jul26" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-jul26').setView([49.1947, -123.1784], 12);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  var mYVR = L.marker([49.1947, -123.1784], { icon: dot('#C62828') }).addTo(map);
  mYVR.bindPopup('<b>Vancouver International Airport</b><br>Terminal: International<br><a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Vancouver+International+Airport" target="_blank">Open in Maps →</a>');
  window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: mYVR, lat: 49.1947, lng: -123.1784 });
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<div class="event-card activity" style="border-color:#5C6BC0;background:#F8F8FF">
  <div class="event-time">💤</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">😴 Jet Lag Strategy</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">In-Flight Sleep Plan — Reset to KST</div>
    <div class="event-notes">
      Vancouver → Seoul crosses <strong>16 time zones eastward</strong> — the tougher direction. The goal is to land at 16:05 KST feeling functional, then push through to 21:00 KST bedtime. Follow this flight plan:
      <div style="margin-top:12px">
        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0">

          <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 12px;background:#EDE7F6;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;border-left:4px solid #7E57C2">
            <div style="min-width:100px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#4527A0">13:00–15:00 PDT<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:#7E57C2">05:00–07:00 KST</span></div>
            <div><strong>Stay awake</strong> — it's afternoon for your body. Eat the meal service, watch a movie, get settled.</div>
          </div>

          <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 12px;background:#E8EAF6;border-left:4px solid #3F51B5">
            <div style="min-width:100px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#1A237E">15:00–15:30 PDT<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:#5C6BC0">07:00–07:30 KST</span></div>
            <div><strong>Wind down</strong> — take melatonin (0.5–1mg low dose works best), put on eye mask and neck pillow, recline seat.</div>
          </div>

          <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 12px;background:#E3F2FD;border-left:4px solid #1565C0">
            <div style="min-width:100px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#0D47A1">15:30–22:00 PDT<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:#1565C0">07:30–14:00 KST</span></div>
            <div><strong>😴 SLEEP</strong> — aim for ~6 hours. This is the critical window. Even if it feels unnatural (your body says it's afternoon), use the eye mask, earplugs, and blanket. Avoid checking the time.</div>
          </div>

          <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 12px;background:#E8F5E9;border-left:4px solid #2E7D32">
            <div style="min-width:100px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#1B5E20">22:00–00:05 PDT<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:#2E7D32">14:00–16:05 KST</span></div>
            <div><strong>Wake up</strong> — ~2 hrs before landing. Freshen up, eat the pre-landing meal, open the window shade, get into Seoul headspace. ☀️</div>
          </div>

          <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 12px;background:#FFF9C4;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;border-left:4px solid #F9A825">
            <div style="min-width:100px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#E65100">16:05 KST<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:#F9A825">00:05 PDT</span></div>
            <div><strong>Land in Seoul</strong> — your body thinks it's midnight, but it's 4pm in Korea. The plan from here is on the Jul 27 page. 🇰🇷</div>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:#777">💊 <strong>Melatonin tip:</strong> low dose (0.5mg) taken 30 min before your target sleep time works better than the standard 5mg pill. Available at Shoppers Drug Mart before the flight.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
